plan: Deep-copy the recipe so adapt never mutates inputs; print_original returns authored_text unchanged.
Compute scale = target_yield / yield and multiply every ingredient quantity (top-level and components) as Fractions.
Index the catalog by 'for' name, sorted by (priority, catalog index) for deterministic choice.

Resolve each excluded ingredient by walking substitution chains: apply name, quantity_factor, unit, preparation, wording_changes, equipment add/remove, yield_factor, and queue additional ingredients; detect cycles via the visited-name chain.
Run queued additional ingredients through the same resolver so chained adaptations and reintroduced exclusions are handled.
Accumulate every independent impossibility reason (no substitution, cycle, unavailable equipment) in a set; never stop at the first.
If any reasons: return possible=False, recipe=None, sorted reasons/warnings, choices considered.

Otherwise assemble the adapted recipe: set yield to target, compensate for yield_factors, sort equipment, apply wording changes to all instruction strings, and return sorted warnings with ordered choice IDs.
Include an executable __main__ acceptance suite covering all seven contract scenarios plus a cycle case.

catalog index sorted by (priority, catalog order) for deterministic selection
chain-walking substitution resolver with visited-name cycle detection
pending queue for substitution-introduced additional ingredients
